in_hebrew.name: שמריאל
in_hebrew.meaning: שומר ישראל, שמריאל משמעותו שומר האל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שמריאל הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו 'שומר האל' או 'אל שומרו'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'שמר' שפירושו שומר, ו'אל' שפירושו אלוהים. השם שמריאל מופיע בתנ"ך כדמות רוחנית ששומרת על ישראל.

in_greek.name: Σαμαριήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Σαμαριήλ είναι ένα όνομα ελληνικό που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα. Σημαίνει 'ο φύλακας του Θεού' ή 'Θεός φυλάκας'. Το όνομα Σαμαριήλ έχει τις ρίζες του στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας και συνδέεται με την έννοια της προστασίας και της φροντίδας του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Samariel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Samariel origine hebraicum est, sed in latinitatem translatum est. Significat 'custos Dei' vel 'Deus custos'. Nomen hoc in traditione christiana significat protectionem et curam Dei.

in_english.name: Samariel
in_english.meaning: Guardian of God, God is my guardian
in_english.long_meaning: Samariel is a Christian name derived from Hebrew roots, meaning 'guardian of God' or 'God is my guardian'. The name combines 'shamar' (to keep, guard) and 'El' (God), signifying divine protection and care. Historically, the name Samariel has been used in Christian tradition to denote a spiritual guardian or protector. It symbolizes a strong connection with faith and divine guidance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Samariel holds cultural significance as it is a reminder of the historical presence of the Samaritan people in biblical times. The name highlights the unique blend of Jewish and Greek influences that shaped the culture of Samaria, adding depth to one's cultural identity.
data.spiritual_significance: Samariel is a meaningful name spiritually as it represents the connection to the divine presence of God in ancient Samaria. It reminds us of God's guidance and protection of the Samaritan people, and encourages us to seek a deeper relationship with God, no matter our cultural background.
